ocumentId":"D4","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"邻铺织席人测量芦苇长度，不使用瓷碗、夹具或金粉。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-HXP9","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Ad2da913c-9813-4c88-af3d-84fcab9365c4:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:d2da913c-9813-4c88-af3d-84fcab9365c4"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["邻铺织席人测量芦苇长度，不使用瓷碗、夹具或金粉。"]},{"documentId":"D5","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"陶未看过旧账，以为金粉在一号柜；白榆知道金粉已经分到二号柜。白榆依据碗沿裂口准备窄夹具，并通知陶未取金粉。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-HXP9","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Ae0828a13-6fa1-42bc-bdef-f618626134d0:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:e0828a13-6fa1-42bc-bdef-f618626134d0"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["陶未看过旧账，以为金粉在一号柜；白榆知道金粉已经分到二号柜。白榆依据碗沿裂口准备窄夹具，并通知陶未取金粉。"]},{"documentId":"D6","title":"白榆","kind":"entity","text":"白榆","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"aliases":[],"canonicalLabel":"白榆","entityType":"character","sourceIdentity":{"resourceKind":"character","sourceUid":"res:v1:character:517c1f36-159d-480a-a7ed-cc5105a1e002","subKey":"root"}},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["白榆"]},{"documentId":"D7","title":"陶未","kind":"entity","text":"陶未","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"aliases":[],"canonicalLabel":"陶未","entityType":"character","sourceIdentity":{"resourceKind":"character","sourceUid":"res:v1:character:b05bc197-315c-408d-800c-e88fac610032","subKey":"root"}},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["陶未"]}]}
